Item Class: Jewels
Rarity: Rare
Oblivion Prism
Small Cluster Jewel
--------
Requirements:
Level: 54
--------
Item Level: 75
--------
{ Enchant Modifier }
Adds 2 Passive Skills (enchant)
(Added Passive Skills are never considered to be in Radius by other Jewels)
{ Enchant Modifier }
Added Small Passive Skills grant: 4% increased maximum Life (enchant)
--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Fervent" (Tier: 1) }
1 Added Passive Skill is Sage — Unscalable Value
{ Suffix Modifier "of the Gale" (Tier: 3) — Elemental, Chaos, Resistance }
Added Small Passive Skills also grant: +3% to Chaos Resistance
{ Suffix Modifier "of the Wise" (Tier: 2) — Attribute }
Added Small Passive Skills also grant: +2 to Intelligence
--------
Place into an allocated Small, Medium or Large Jewel Socket on the Passive Skill Tree. Added passives do not interact with jewel radiuses. Right click to remove from the Socket.
